svg.title: DIA-001 · One hundred billion dials
svg.desc: An engraved plate. A strip of paper across the top carries the sentence "A modern AI model is a very large file of", with the next word hidden under a hatched slip. Below it a panel of identical dials runs back to the horizon and off both sides of the plate. Each dial in the front rows has its setting written under it as a number. One dial at the front is drawn in rust, with a dashed line showing where its pointer stood a moment ago: it has been turned a hair, from 0.4172 to 0.4173.
svg.text: PART I · SECTION 1 · WHAT'S BEING BUILT
A modern AI model is a very large file of
Show it a sentence with the next word covered.
About 100 billion dials. Each setting is one number.
So this dial is turned a hair: 0.4172 becomes 0.4173. So are the rest.
Billions of times, trillions of words.
DIA-001 · The model is the settings: a file of numbers, each nudged a hair after every wrong guess at the next word.
